segments: Title card "Breadland" appears over wide shot of isolated bread store in the night.
A blue creature holding cigarette and sitting at a table presses a large "dispense bread" button. The floor is checked and the walls are green and orange.
A green creature arrives holding bread on a tray and places it on the blue creature's table.
When placing the tray down, the green creature knocks the blue creature's cigarette off the table and under a closed door.
The blue creature runs after the cigarette and sees a circle with a diagonal cross through it labelled on the door. The green creature reacts in fear.
The blue creature puts his hand on the door handle and the green creature shakes his head with a scared expression.
The blue creature cracks the door open and the green creature flips out in fear, but the blue creature gives him the finger.
The blue creature opens the door more, seeing a dark, swirling void.
A tentacle reaches out and grabs the blue creature into the void.
Landing on a white surface, the blue creature gets up and is scared to see a giant white creature.
The giant white creature nonverbally communicates: "You should not have come here," and the blue creature runs.
The white creature uses his giant hand to catch the running blue creature and lifts him up.
The white creature nonverbally communicates: "You must be punished for your hubris."
The white creature drops the blue creature into his open mouth, making him fall through a void and land on a checkered floor where the green creature stands. The screen cuts to black.
